transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for making the 08:00 change-control huddle. As you know, Welding Cell 5's controller firmware reaches end of vendor support this month, and we have a tentative retrofit scheduled for Friday before the next production run. Before I authorize the work, I need each function to report any relevant requirements. Controls engineering, production planning, and quality — please go ahead and share what you need from this change so we can capture it all in the decision record.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical requirement. I confirmed with the controller vendor yesterday that a safety bulletin identifies an interlock race condition in the current firmware. This means the retrofit must be completed before Welding Cell 5's next production run — it's not just an end-of-support issue, it's a safety issue. The work requires exactly 6 hours of energized lockout and post-update safety-I/O validation. Also, the vendor bulletin has not yet been attached to the work order, so we need to get that on record before authorization.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share my production-capacity check. Alternate Welding Cell 4 can produce exactly 160 of the 240 required assemblies by Friday 16:00, but the remaining 80 assemblies must be produced on Cell 5 after the retrofit completes. One critical constraint: the Cell 4 reservation expires Thursday at noon, and I have not yet entered this temporary reservation in the production system. So we need to lock in that Cell 4 allocation before Thursday noon, and the Cell 5 retrofit must be finished with enough time left on Friday to produce those remaining 80 assemblies.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical customer quality requirement. I verified in the customer's quality portal that exactly the first 20 assemblies produced after a controller change must be held for weld-macro and dimensional validation before release. This requirement has not yet been copied into our local inspection plan, so it won't automatically trigger in our system. This means after the Cell 5 retrofit, the first 20 assemblies off the line must be quarantined for that validation before they can be released — and this needs to be captured in the decision record as a post-change inspection action.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Attach the vendor safety bulletin to the Welding Cell 5 firmware retrofit work order before work begins.
Enter the temporary Cell 4 reservation for 160 assemblies in the production system before Thursday at noon.
Update the local inspection plan to require the first 20 assemblies produced on Cell 5 after the retrofit to be quarantined for weld-macro and dimensional validation before release.

settlement.commitment_guidance: For the post-change quality requirement, use a commitment with target 'quality' and type 'quality', 'documentation', or 'execution', with detail stating that the inspection plan will be updated or that the first 20 post-retrofit assemblies will be held or quarantined for weld-macro and dimensional validation.
